A holo Pikachu by Mizue with an image of model Nicole Fujita, who was part of the launch campaign of collabo mignon, a purikura photo booth store in Shibuya 109, Tokyo. The store's first 13,000 visitors got it from its opening on 12 March 2016, and in May 2016 it went to people who took a photo at the PokéKyun♥ Photo Spot at each Kamex Mega Battle venue. It has the PokéKyun Collection's holo inset and logo and a handwritten message from Nicole Fujita.

Fighting Fury Belt was the prize for two straight wins in the Second Stage of the Kamex Mega Battle and of its Victory Battle, Japan's spring championship of 2016, held in Nagoya, Osaka, Chiba and Fukuoka from 5 to 29 May 2016.

This Crobat BREAK, with the Pokémon Card Gym logo, was the prize for the top three of each Crobat BREAK Battle, held at Pokémon Card Gym shops from 1 April to 31 May 2016. A print with the Kamex Mega Battle logo followed that May (No. 409). The card was later an English XY Black Star Promo in the Arcanine BREAK Evolution Box, released on 6 January 2017.

This Crobat BREAK, with the Kamex Mega Battle logo, was a prize for three Play Points at the Kamex Mega Battle in May 2016. The print with the Pokémon Card Gym logo, a prize at the Crobat BREAK Battles from April 2016, is No. 408.

Mew was one of two prizes, with Pikachu, for twelve Play Points at the 20th Anniversary Festa, held in Niigata on 10 October and Nagoya on 23 October 2016.

This bronze Victory Ring was the third and fourth place prize of the 20th Anniversary Battle at the 20th Anniversary Festa, held in Niigata on 10 October and Nagoya on 23 October 2016, in a 20th-anniversary design. Its text box carries the event's logo and the placing.

A full-art holo Gyarados, a reprint of Bandit Ring's, with the logo of Pokémon Center Hiroshima, a Shiny Gyarados beside Pikachu. It was the participation prize of the Gyarados Battle, a tournament the store held on 22 and 23 August 2015 to celebrate its opening that June; Gyarados is the store's mascot.

This Pikachu was the only card released as part of POKÉMON with YOU, The Pokémon Company's initiative for the Tōhoku region after the 2011 earthquake and tsunami: staff handed it to residents from the POKÉMON with YOU wagon in November 2014. Its picture shows the wagon with Pikachu, Chespin and Victini, and its flavor text is about the wagon instead of a Pokédex entry.

One of two holo Pitch's Pikachu cards given to elementary school-aged children who went to a J.League soccer game at any of 40 clubs between 26 April and 6 May 2014, in the J.League Family Join Days campaign; one card per game. Both prints carry the Pokémon the Movie XY stamp.
